review.contents: Supplementary Figure 1: eight histology panels of the primary tumor (A to D) and the subcutaneous metastasis (E to H) with a printed caption.
review.clinical_relevance_notes: Patient tumor histology images whose printed caption states findings and a size.

visual.general_description: Eight histology fields in two rows: primary cutaneous melanoma (A to D) and subcutaneous metastasis (E to H), with a bold caption below.
visual.detailed_description: Two rows with rotated row labels I - Primary CM and II - SC metastasis. Top row A to D: low-power tumor overview, surface ulceration field, epithelioid cells with a vessel marked by an arrowhead, and a Ki-67 immunohistochemistry field with brown nuclei. Bottom row E to H: whole-lesion overview, high-power epithelioid cells, fibrotic and fat zones, and a lymphocyte-rich field. A caption printed below describes each letter.

Field labelled G with pale pink fibrotic areas and white fat spaces
